zh: 跪在垫子上，双手握住健腹轮，放在膝盖正下方，骨盆后倾，含胸卷腹。
全程保持骨盆后倾，核心收紧，不要塌腰。
呼气，缓慢把轮子向前推出，只推到你能控制不塌腰的幅度。
停顿片刻，吸气收腹，把轮子拉回起始位置。
做不动时缩小幅度，也可以靠墙减少行程。
en: Kneel on a mat holding the ab roller under the shoulders, pelvis tucked and chest rounded.
Keep the pelvis tucked and the core braced throughout, with no sagging lower back.
Exhale and slowly roll forward only as far as you can control without the lower back sagging.
Pause briefly, then pull the abs in and roll back to the start.
Shorten the range if you struggle, or roll toward a wall to limit the distance.

zh: 坐在凳子上（靠背调直），双脚踩稳，双手持哑铃放在胸前，掌心朝向自己，手肘在身体前侧。
核心收紧，沉肩，开始向上推起，同时让手臂向外旋转。
到顶部时掌心朝前，手臂接近伸直但不锁死。
吸气，缓慢下放，同时把掌心旋回朝向自己，回到起始位置。
肩内旋受限者慎做，肩部不适时优先选 地雷管推举。
en: Sit on a bench with the back pad upright and feet planted, dumbbells held in front of the chest with palms facing you and elbows in front of the body.
Brace the core, set the shoulders down and begin pressing up while rotating the arms outward.
At the top the palms face forward and the arms are nearly straight but not locked.
Inhale and lower slowly, rotating the palms back toward you, to the start position.
Be careful if your internal rotation is limited, and prefer a landmine press if the shoulder is irritated.

zh: 调好辅助配重（或弹力带挂在杠上），跪在或站在辅助垫上，握住引体向上杆，手臂伸直。
先沉肩启动背阔肌，核心收紧。
呼气，手肘向下向后，把身体拉到下巴过杆。
吸气，缓慢控制下放回到手臂接近伸直，使用完整行程。
随着力量提高，逐步减少辅助配重。
en: Set the assistance weight (or loop a band over the bar), kneel or stand on the assist pad and grip the bar with straight arms.
Start by setting the shoulders down to engage the lats, with the core braced.
Exhale and drive the elbows down and back, pulling up until the chin clears the bar.
Inhale and lower under control to nearly straight arms, using the full range.
As you get stronger, gradually reduce the assistance.

zh: 调好卡垫位置，使其在髋部折痕下方，脚跟卡稳，双手交叉放胸前或抱重量。
身体从头到脚保持一条直线，脊柱中立，躯干在顶端位置。
吸气，髋部铰链向下，躯干下放到髋部折叠，背部保持平直。
呼气，靠臀和腘绳肌发力起身，回到身体成一条直线。
不要超伸折腰，起身只到身体成直线为止。
en: Set the pad just below the hip crease, hook the heels securely and cross the arms over the chest or hold a weight.
Start with the body in one straight line from head to heels, spine neutral.
Inhale and hinge at the hips to lower the torso, keeping the back flat.
Exhale and rise using the glutes and hamstrings until the body is back in one line.
Don't over-extend the lower back; stop when the body forms a straight line.

zh: 把弹力带固定在与肘同高的位置，侧身站立，靠近锚点一侧的手握住弹力带，大臂夹紧体侧（可垫毛巾）。
屈肘 90°，小臂指向身体前方，手腕保持中立。
呼气，大臂不动，沿轻阻力向外旋转小臂，强化冈下肌与小圆肌。
转到无痛的最大角度停 1 秒，吸气缓慢还原。
一侧做完全部次数后换另一侧，用轻阻力，慢速完成。
en: Anchor a band at elbow height, stand side-on to it, hold the band with the hand nearest the anchor and tuck the upper arm against your side (a towel under it helps).
Bend the elbow 90° with the forearm pointing forward and the wrist neutral.
Exhale and rotate the forearm outward against light resistance with the upper arm staying still, strengthening the infraspinatus and teres minor.
Pause 1 second at the end of your pain-free range, then return slowly.
Finish all reps on one side, then switch; use light resistance and a slow tempo.

zh: 把轻弹力带固定在眼睛高度的位置，双手握住带子，后退一步，让带子有张力。
沉肩，核心收紧，手臂向前伸直。
呼气，把带子拉向额头，手肘高抬并向两侧分开。
在末端向外上方转动小臂成「投降」姿势，停 1 秒。
吸气缓慢还原，阻力要轻，不耸肩。
en: Anchor a light band at eye height, hold the ends, and step back so there is tension on the band.
Set the shoulders down, brace the core and reach the arms forward.
Exhale and pull the band toward the forehead with the elbows high and wide.
At the end rotate the forearms up and out into a “surrender” pose and pause 1 second.
Inhale and return slowly; keep the resistance light and don't shrug.

zh: 把杠铃架在上背（斜方肌下方），双手握杠，退出支架，双脚略宽于肩，脚尖微外展。
吸气，核心绷紧建立腹内压，保持脊柱中立。
髋膝同步屈曲下蹲，膝盖与脚尖同向，下蹲到大腿平行地面或你能控制的深度。
呼气，脚掌踩实发力站起，髋和肩同步上升，全程脊柱不弓背。
肩部不适或握杠不舒服时，可改用高脚杯深蹲或腿举。
en: Set the bar on the upper back (below the traps), grip it, step out of the rack and stand with feet slightly wider than the shoulders, toes turned out a little.
Inhale and brace the core against intra-abdominal pressure, keeping the spine neutral.
Squat down with hips and knees bending together, knees tracking over the toes, to thighs parallel or the deepest depth you can control.
Exhale and drive through the whole foot to stand, with hips and shoulders rising together and no rounding of the back.
If the shoulders or the bar grip bother you, use goblet squats or leg press instead.

zh: 仰卧在平凳上，双脚踩实地面，握距略宽于肩，肩胛后缩下沉并抵住凳面。
把杠铃从架上推起至肩关节正上方，吸气稳住核心。
控制下放杠铃至乳头连线附近，小臂保持垂直地面，手肘约 45° 贴向身体。
呼气发力推起，沿稳定轨迹回到起始位置，全程臀部和肩胛不离凳。
完成次数后把杠铃稳稳放回挂钩，重量大时请保护者协助。
en: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted, grip slightly wider than the shoulders, and set the shoulder blades back and down against the bench.
Unrack the bar and hold it directly over the shoulder joints; breathe in and brace the core.
Lower the bar under control to the nipple line, forearms vertical and elbows about 45° from the torso.
Press up along a steady path, keeping hips and shoulder blades on the bench the whole time.
After the last rep, rack the bar securely; use a spotter for heavy sets.

zh: 坐在地上，肩胛骨下缘靠在凳子上，杠铃放在髋部（可垫护垫），双脚踩地与髋同宽，屈膝。
下巴微收，核心收紧，双手扶稳杠铃。
呼气，臀部发力向上顶髋，顶峰时小腿垂直地面，膝髋肩成一条直线。
夹紧臀部停 1 秒，肋骨向下收，不要顶腰或让肋骨外翻。
吸气缓慢放下，下一次从臀部发力开始。
en: Sit on the floor with the lower edge of the shoulder blades against a bench, the bar over the hips (with a pad) and feet hip-width, knees bent.
Tuck the chin slightly, brace the core and hold the bar steady.
Exhale and drive the hips up with the glutes until the shins are vertical and knees, hips and shoulders form a line.
Squeeze the glutes for 1 second with the ribs down, no lower-back arching or rib flare.
Inhale and lower slowly, starting each rep from the glutes.

zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，握住杠铃置于大腿前侧，膝盖微屈，沉肩并收紧背阔肌。
吸气，核心收紧，屁股向后推，杠铃贴腿下放至胫骨中段。
全程背部中立，严禁弯腰弓背，下放到腘绳肌被明显拉伸为止。
呼气，臀部发力向前顶髋站直，杠铃贴腿拉回起始位置。
膝盖角度全程不变，顶峰锁定后不要过度后仰。
en: Stand with feet hip-width, hold the bar in front of the thighs with knees slightly bent, shoulders down and lats tight.
Inhale, brace the core and push the hips back, lowering the bar against the legs to mid-shin.
Keep the back neutral throughout and never round it; stop when the hamstrings are well stretched.
Exhale and drive the hips forward with the glutes to stand, pulling the bar back up close to the legs.
Keep the knee angle unchanged and don't lean back at lockout.

zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，握住杠铃，髋铰链向后推，俯身约 45°，膝盖微屈。
核心收紧，背部保持平直，沉肩，杠铃悬在膝盖下方。
呼气，贴着大腿把杠铃拉向下腹，手肘向后。
顶峰停 1 秒，夹紧背部，躯干角度不变。
吸气缓慢下放，全程背部不弓，不用腰部借力甩动。
en: Stand feet hip-width, hold the barbell, push the hips back and hinge forward to about 45° with the knees slightly bent.
Brace the core, keep the back flat and shoulders down, with the bar hanging below the knees.
Exhale and row the bar close to the legs toward the lower belly, elbows going back.
Pause 1 second at the top, squeezing the back, with the torso angle unchanged.
Lower under control, keeping the back flat and not heaving with the lower back.

zh: 开始前先慢跑和动态拉伸 5–10 分钟，热身髋、膝和踝。
进入比赛或对抗，算一次中高强度间歇训练，注意节奏，累了就换人休息。
跳跃和变向时注意落地缓冲，膝盖与脚尖同向，不内扣。
结束后慢走 5 分钟放松，并做腿部和髋部拉伸。
第二天不要紧接着安排大重量下肢训练。
en: Warm up with 5–10 minutes of easy jogging and dynamic stretches for the hips, knees and ankles.
Play the game or drills as one medium-to-high-intensity interval session, pacing yourself and subbing out when tired.
Land softly on jumps and cuts, with the knees tracking over the toes and not caving in.
Cool down with 5 minutes of easy walking and stretch the legs and hips.
Don't schedule heavy lower-body work the next day.

zh: 坐姿，把杠铃放在颈后上背，握距比肩宽较多，背部挺直，核心收紧。
呼气，把杠铃垂直向上推过头顶，手臂接近伸直。
吸气，缓慢下放到耳朵高度，不要继续下压到颈后。
该动作的极端外展加外旋体位对肩袖与前侧关节囊压力极大，使用轻重量。
肩部不适者避免此动作，可换成 地雷管推举 或上斜哑铃推举。
en: Sit upright with the bar resting behind the neck on the upper back, a grip much wider than the shoulders, back tall and core braced.
Exhale and press the bar straight up overhead until the arms are nearly straight.
Inhale and lower slowly to about ear height, not lower behind the neck.
The extreme abducted and externally rotated position puts a lot of stress on the rotator cuff and the front joint capsule, so use a light weight.
If your shoulder is irritated, skip this and use a landmine press or an incline dumbbell press instead.

zh: 坐稳并压好大腿垫，握距比肩宽，身体直立，核心收紧。
呼气，把横杆向下拉到颈后上背位置，手肘向下向后。
吸气缓慢还原，让手臂伸直，不要借力。
该动作没有额外的背阔肌收益，且迫使颈椎前探、肩关节处于极端位置，使用轻重量。
肩部不适者避免此动作，可换成身前的正手或对握高位下拉。
en: Sit down, lock the thigh pad, take a grip wider than the shoulders with the torso upright and the core braced.
Exhale and pull the bar down behind the neck to the upper back, driving the elbows down and back.
Inhale and return slowly until the arms are straight, without using momentum.
There is no extra lat benefit, and it forces the neck forward and the shoulders into an extreme position, so use a light weight.
If your shoulder is irritated, skip this and use a front pulldown with an overhand or neutral grip instead.

zh: 四足跪姿，双手在肩正下方，双膝在髋正下方，背部平直，核心收紧。
骨盆与腰椎保持水平静止，呼气，缓慢向前伸出一侧手臂并同时向后伸出对侧腿。
伸到手臂和腿与躯干成一条直线，停 2 秒，不要塌腰或转髋。
吸气，缓慢收回，回到起始位置。
交替换侧，做完全部次数，节奏缓慢。
en: Start on all fours with hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips, back flat and core braced.
Keep the pelvis and lower back level and still; exhale and slowly reach one arm forward while extending the opposite leg back.
Extend until the arm and leg are in line with the torso, hold 2 seconds, with no sagging back or twisting hips.
Inhale and return slowly to the start.
Alternate sides for all reps at a slow pace.

zh: 背对凳子站立，一只脚的脚背放在凳子上，另一只脚向前迈一大步，前脚离凳较远。
躯干略前倾可更多练到臀部，核心收紧；练前吃够碳水。
吸气，用约 2 秒控制下蹲，前膝朝向脚尖，后膝接近地面。
呼气，前脚掌踩实发力站起，回到起始位置。
一侧完成全部次数后换另一侧。
en: Stand facing away from a bench, put the top of one foot on it and step the other foot a long way forward.
Lean the torso slightly forward to work the glutes more and brace the core; eat enough carbs beforehand.
Inhale and lower for 2 seconds, the front knee tracking over the toes and the back knee nearing the floor.
Exhale and drive through the front foot to stand back up.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch.

zh: 面对低位滑轮站立，握住直杆或绳索，双脚与髋同宽，核心收紧，沉肩。
大臂贴紧肋骨两侧并保持不动。
呼气，屈肘把把手卷向肩部，全程保持二头肌张力。
顶峰停顿片刻，吸气缓慢控制下放，不让配重片砸下。
完成次数，躯干不要借力后仰。
en: Stand facing a low pulley holding a straight bar or rope, feet hip-width, core braced and shoulders down.
Pin the upper arms to the sides of your ribs and keep them still.
Exhale and curl the handle toward the shoulders, keeping tension on the biceps all the way through.
Pause briefly at the top, then inhale and lower under control without letting the stack crash.
Complete all reps without leaning back to cheat.

zh: 面对高位滑轮跪下，握住绳索放在头两侧，臀部坐在脚跟上，核心收紧。
髋部固定不动，吸气稳住躯干。
呼气，像虾米一样卷曲胸椎，让肘部靠向大腿，带动腹直肌收缩。
顶峰停顿片刻，吸气缓慢还原到起始位置。
全程髋部不动，用腹肌而不是手臂拉动。
en: Kneel facing a high pulley, hold the rope beside the head with the glutes resting on the heels and the core braced.
Keep the hips fixed in place and breathe in to steady the torso.
Exhale and curl the upper spine like a shrimp, bringing the elbows toward the thighs so the rectus abdominis contracts.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then inhale and return slowly to the start.
Keep the hips still the whole time and use the abs, not the arms, to pull.

zh: 把滑轮调到略高于眼睛的位置，装上绳索，双手握住绳端，后退几步站稳，选轻重量（≤ 18 kg）。
沉肩，收紧核心，手臂向前伸直，保持张力。
呼气，把绳索拉向额头高度，手肘高抬并向两侧分开，同时做肩外旋。
结尾做出「投降」姿势（手肘高、小臂向上）停 1 秒，不要耸肩。
吸气缓慢还原，严禁大重量耸肩拉。
en: Set the pulley slightly above eye level with a rope attachment, hold the rope ends, step back to a stable stance and choose a light weight (≤ 18 kg).
Set the shoulders down, brace the core and reach the arms forward with tension on the rope.
Exhale and pull toward forehead height with the elbows high and wide, externally rotating the shoulders as you go.
Finish in a “surrender” pose (elbows high, forearms up) and hold 1 second, with no shrugging.
Inhale and return slowly; never shrug heavy weight.

zh: 把滑轮调到高位，双手各握一个把手，向前迈一步站稳，躯干略前倾。
手肘微弯固定，双臂向两侧斜上方展开到胸部有拉伸感。
呼气，沿弧线向小腹前方环抱下压，双手在下腹前合拢。
合拢处夹紧胸肌停 1 秒，再吸气缓慢还原。
全程手肘角度不变，肩部下沉，避免耸肩。
en: Set the pulleys high, hold a handle in each hand, and step forward into a stable stance with a slight forward lean.
Keep a slight fixed bend in the elbows and open the arms out and up until you feel a chest stretch.
Exhale and hug down and together in an arc until the hands meet in front of the lower belly.
Squeeze the chest and pause 1 second at the peak, then inhale and return slowly.
Keep the elbow angle constant and the shoulders down, no shrugging.

zh: 把滑轮调至肩胸高度，双手各握一个把手，向前迈一步成弓步站稳，躯干略前倾。
手肘微弯并固定这个角度，双臂向两侧展开到胸部有拉伸感即可。
呼气，像环抱大树一样向胸前合拢双臂，合拢处停 1 秒夹紧胸肌。
吸气缓慢还原，不要过度后拉，以免肩部受伤。
全程手肘角度不变，用胸肌而不是手臂发力。
en: Set the pulleys at shoulder-to-chest height, hold a handle in each hand, and step forward into a split stance with a slight forward lean.
Keep a slight fixed bend in the elbows and open the arms out to the sides until you feel a chest stretch.
Exhale and hug the handles together in front of the chest, pausing 1 second to squeeze.
Inhale and return slowly; don't pull back far enough to strain the shoulder.
Keep the elbow angle constant and let the chest, not the arms, do the work.

zh: 侧对低位滑轮站立，远离滑轮一侧的手握住把手，另一只手扶稳，沉肩。
手肘微弯固定，让绳索从身前经过，保持恒定张力。
呼气，手肘引领向侧上方抬起，抬到与肩同高，不耸肩。
顶峰停顿片刻，吸气缓慢放下，全程保持张力。
一侧做完全部次数后换另一侧。
en: Stand side-on to a low pulley, hold the handle with the hand farthest from the stack, steady yourself with the other hand and set the shoulder down.
Keep a slight fixed bend in the elbow and let the cable cross in front of the body so there is constant tension.
Exhale and lead with the elbow up and out to shoulder height, without shrugging.
Pause briefly at the top, then inhale and lower slowly, keeping tension throughout.
Finish all reps on one side, then switch.

zh: 面对高位滑轮，半跪或坐姿，单手握住把手，另一只手扶稳，躯干挺直。
先沉肩，再让手臂在头顶方向被轻轻拉直，感到背阔肌拉伸。
呼气，手肘向同侧髋部方向下拉，顶峰停 1 秒夹紧背阔肌。
吸气缓慢还原，不要让肩膀被拉得耸起。
一侧做完全部次数后换另一侧。
en: Face the high pulley in a half-kneeling or seated position, hold the handle in one hand and keep the torso tall.
Set the shoulder down first, then let the arm extend overhead until you feel a lat stretch.
Exhale and pull the elbow toward the same-side hip, pausing 1 second at the peak to squeeze the lat.
Inhale and return slowly, without letting the shoulder get dragged up.
Finish all reps on one side, then switch.

zh: 背对低位滑轮站立，双腿跨过绳索，双手握住绳端，向前迈一步让绳索有张力。
膝盖微屈，核心收紧，背部保持平直。
吸气，屈髋向后送臀，让双手穿过两腿之间，感到腘绳肌拉伸。
呼气，臀部发力向前顶髋站直，夹紧臀部。
全程手臂只是挂在身前，下背压力极小。
en: Stand facing away from a low pulley, straddle the cable, hold the rope ends and step forward until there is tension.
Keep the knees slightly bent, core braced and back flat.
Inhale and hinge, sending the hips back so the hands pass between the legs and the hamstrings stretch.
Exhale and drive the hips forward with the glutes to stand tall, squeezing the glutes.
The arms just hang in front; lower-back stress stays very low.

zh: 面对高位滑轮站立，握住绳索，双脚与髋同宽，身体略前倾，沉肩。
大臂贴紧身体两侧并保持不动，手肘屈曲至约 90°。
呼气，伸肘向下压绳索，到底部把绳索向两侧分开，挤压三头肌 1 秒。
吸气缓慢还原，小臂回到约 90°，大臂始终不动。
完成次数，全程肩部不耸起。
en: Stand facing a high pulley holding the rope, feet hip-width, torso slightly forward and shoulders down.
Pin the upper arms to your sides and keep them still, elbows bent to about 90°.
Exhale and extend the elbows to press the rope down, spreading the rope apart at the bottom and squeezing the triceps for 1 second.
Inhale and return slowly until the forearms are back at about 90°, upper arms still.
Complete all reps without letting the shoulders creep up.

zh: 调好斜板或靠垫，胸口贴稳，双脚踩实，握住器械把手或哑铃，手臂自然下垂。
沉肩，让下背完全放松，没有压力。
呼气，沉肩后向两侧体侧拉动重量，同时后缩肩胛。
顶峰停 1 秒，夹紧中背。
吸气缓慢还原，让背部有拉伸感，全程胸口不离靠垫。
en: Set the incline pad or cushion, press the chest firmly against it, plant the feet, and hold the handles or dumbbells with the arms hanging.
Set the shoulders down and let the lower back relax completely.
Exhale and pull the weight toward your sides with the shoulders down, drawing the shoulder blades back.
Pause 1 second at the top, squeezing the mid-back.
Inhale and return slowly until the back is stretched, keeping the chest on the pad throughout.

zh: 反手握杠，握距与肩同宽，悬垂，核心收紧。
沉肩挺胸，让背阔肌和肱二头肌同时启动。
呼气，手肘向下向后，把身体向上拉到下巴过杆。
顶峰停顿片刻，吸气缓慢下放到手臂接近伸直。
全程不借力摆动，做不到标准次数时可改用辅助引体向上。
en: Hang from the bar with an underhand grip at shoulder width and the core braced.
Set the shoulders down and lift the chest so the lats and biceps engage together.
Exhale and drive the elbows down and back, pulling up until the chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top, then inhale and lower slowly until the arms are nearly straight.
Don't swing for momentum; use the assisted pull-up if you can't do full reps.

zh: 仰卧在平凳上，双脚踩实，肩胛后缩下沉，双手握杠，握距与肩同宽（不必过窄伤手腕）。
把杠铃从架上推起至肩关节上方，核心收紧。
吸气，手肘贴近躯干缓慢下放，杠铃落到下胸位置。
呼气，手肘贴近躯干推起，回到起始位置，三头肌发力。
完成次数后把杠铃放回挂钩，肩部不适时可换成绳索下压。
en: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted and shoulder blades back and down, hold the bar with hands about shoulder-width apart (no need to go narrower and hurt the wrists).
Unrack the bar over the shoulder joints and brace the core.
Inhale and lower slowly with the elbows close to the torso until the bar touches the lower chest.
Exhale and press up with the elbows close to the torso, driving with the triceps.
Rack the bar at the end; if your shoulder is irritated, use cable pushdowns instead.

zh: 坐稳并压好大腿垫，反手握杆，握距与肩同宽或略窄，身体略后倾。
先沉肩，再吸气把横杆拉向下巴到上胸位置，手肘向下向后收。
拉到最低点时挺胸夹紧背阔肌下部，停 1 秒，注意不要耸肩。
吸气缓慢还原，让手臂完全伸直、背阔肌充分拉伸，再开始下一次。
上斜方肌容易代偿，如果肩颈发紧就降低重量。
en: Sit down, lock the thigh pad, and take an underhand grip at or just inside shoulder width, leaning back slightly.
Set the shoulders down first, then pull the bar toward the chin / upper chest, driving the elbows down and back.
At the bottom, lift the chest and squeeze the lower lats for 1 second without shrugging.
Return slowly until the arms are fully straight and the lats are fully stretched before the next rep.
The upper traps tend to take over, so lower the weight if the neck and shoulders tighten up.

zh: 双脚与髋同宽，杠铃在脚掌中部上方，贴近胫骨，髋铰链下蹲，双手握杠，握距略比腿宽。
吸气，核心绷紧，沉肩并收紧背阔肌，把杠铃的余量拉紧，保持背部平直。
双脚蹬地同时伸髋，杠铃贴着腿向上拉起，严禁圆背。
站直时臀部发力夹紧，不要过度后仰。
控制下放杠铃贴着腿回到地面，每次重新绷紧再开始。
en: Stand with feet hip-width and the bar over the mid-foot, close to the shins; hinge down and take a grip just outside the legs.
Inhale, brace the core, set the shoulders down and tighten the lats to take the slack out of the bar, back flat.
Drive the floor away and extend the hips together, pulling the bar up along the legs, and never pull with a rounded back.
Finish standing tall with the glutes squeezed, without leaning back.
Lower the bar under control along the legs to the floor, re-bracing before each rep.

zh: 仰卧，双腿屈膝，一侧手臂伸向对侧，让肩胛骨固定在地面上。
用另一只手扣住这侧手臂的上臂（不是手腕），手臂保持低于肩高。
轻轻把上臂向对侧胸前拉，到肩后侧有拉伸感即可，停在弹响之前的无痛角度。
保持 20–30 秒，自然呼吸，不要憋气。
缓慢放回，休息后换另一侧，做完这一侧再做另一侧。
en: Lie on your back with knees bent and one arm reaching across the body, shoulder blade resting on the floor.
Hold that arm with the other hand just above the elbow (not the wrist), keeping it below shoulder height.
Gently pull the upper arm across the chest until you feel a stretch at the back of the shoulder, stopping at a pain-free angle before the click.
Hold for 20–30 seconds, breathing normally.
Release slowly and rest, then switch sides.

zh: 仰卧，双臂举向天花板，髋膝各屈 90°，大腿垂直地面，小腿平行地面。
吐气沉肋骨，下背部始终紧紧贴死地面，保持这个状态。
缓慢延伸一侧手臂向头后和对侧腿向前，手脚不碰地。
吸气收回，再换另一侧，动作交替进行，下背不离地。
每侧交替完成所有次数，节奏缓慢。
en: Lie on your back with the arms reaching toward the ceiling and the hips and knees each bent 90°, thighs vertical and shins parallel to the floor.
Exhale and sink the ribs, pressing the lower back firmly into the floor and keeping it there.
Slowly extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg forward without touching the floor.
Inhale and bring them back, then repeat on the other side, never letting the lower back lift.
Alternate sides for all reps at a slow pace.

zh: 双手撑住双杠，手臂伸直撑起身体，躯干略前倾，核心收紧，沉肩。
吸气，屈肘缓慢下放身体，手肘向后，控制下放深度。
底部大幅度肩过伸对肩关节囊前侧压力很大，下放不要过低。
呼气，撑起身体回到起始位置，手臂接近伸直但不锁死。
肩部不适者避免此动作，三头可换成绳索下压，胸可换成哑铃卧推或龙门架夹胸。
en: Support yourself on parallel bars with the arms straight, torso slightly forward, core braced and shoulders down.
Inhale and bend the elbows to lower the body slowly, elbows going back, controlling the depth.
The deep shoulder hyperextension at the bottom puts a lot of stress on the front shoulder capsule, so don't go too low.
Exhale and press back up to the start, arms nearly straight but not locked.
If your shoulder is irritated, skip this; use cable pushdowns for triceps and dumbbell presses or cable flyes for chest instead.

zh: 站在门框旁，一侧小臂贴在门框上，手肘略高于肩，肘约 90°。
同侧脚向前迈一小步，身体保持挺直，核心收紧。
温和地向前移动躯干，直到胸前有拉伸感；若肩前有刺痛感立刻放低手肘角度。
保持 20–30 秒，自然呼吸，不要耸肩。
缓慢放回，休息后换另一侧。
en: Stand beside a door frame with one forearm on it, elbow slightly above the shoulder and bent about 90°.
Step the same-side foot forward a little, torso tall and core braced.
Gently shift the body forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the chest; lower the elbow at once if you feel a sharp pain at the front of the shoulder.
Hold 20–30 seconds, breathing normally and without shrugging.
Release slowly and rest, then switch sides.

zh: 站姿，双脚与髋同宽，双手各持一只哑铃垂在体侧，掌心朝向身体，沉肩。
大臂固定在身体两侧，核心收紧，不晃腰。
呼气，屈肘举起哑铃，举起过程中小臂旋外至掌心朝上。
顶峰停顿片刻，吸气缓慢控制下放，回到手臂伸直。
双臂同时或交替进行，重量以不借力为准。
en: Stand with feet hip-width, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing the body and shoulders down.
Keep the upper arms fixed at your sides and the core braced, without swaying.
Exhale and curl the dumbbells up, rotating the forearms outward until the palms face up.
Pause briefly at the top, then inhale and lower under control to full extension.
Curl both arms together or alternate; choose a weight you can lift without swinging.

zh: 仰卧在平凳上，双脚踩实，双手各持一只哑铃推到胸上方，掌心相对。
手肘微屈并固定，沉肩，肩胛后缩下沉并抵住凳面。
吸气，向两侧画弧线缓慢下放，下放到大臂与地面平行即可，切勿过度下放拉伤肩前侧。
呼气，沿原弧线抬起哑铃，在胸上方合拢，挤压胸肌。
全程手肘角度不变，使用较轻重量。
en: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand pressed over the chest, palms facing each other.
Keep a slight fixed bend in the elbows, with the shoulder blades back and down against the bench.
Inhale and lower the arms in a wide arc until the upper arms are parallel to the floor, and never lower than that or you will strain the front of the shoulder.
Exhale and sweep the dumbbells back up along the same arc, bringing them together over the chest and squeezing.
Keep the elbow angle constant and use a lighter weight.

zh: 站姿，双脚与髋同宽，双手各持一只哑铃，用中立握（锤式握法）垂在大腿前侧。
核心收紧，沉肩，手肘微弯。
呼气，向正前方抬起哑铃到肩高，不要继续往上。
顶峰停顿片刻，吸气缓慢放下，躯干不要前后晃动。
可以双臂同时或交替进行，重量以不借力为准。
en: Stand with feet hip-width, a dumbbell in each hand in a neutral (hammer) grip, resting in front of the thighs.
Brace the core, keep the shoulders down and the elbows slightly bent.
Exhale and raise the dumbbells straight forward to shoulder height, no higher.
Pause briefly at the top, then inhale and lower under control without rocking the torso.
Raise both arms together or alternate; choose a weight you can lift without momentum.

zh: 站姿，双脚与髋同宽，双手各持一只哑铃垂在体侧，掌心相对（中立握），沉肩。
大臂贴近体侧固定不动，核心收紧，不晃腰。
呼气，屈肘把哑铃向肩部卷起，保持掌心相对，对腕肘关节友好。
顶峰停顿片刻，吸气用约 2 秒控制下放到手臂伸直。
双臂同时或交替进行，重量以不借力摆动为准。
en: Stand with feet hip-width, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing each other (neutral grip) and shoulders down.
Keep the upper arms against your sides and still, core braced, without swaying the lower back.
Exhale and curl the dumbbells toward the shoulders, palms still facing each other; this is friendly to the wrist and elbow.
Pause briefly at the top, then inhale and lower over about 2 seconds to full extension.
Curl both arms together or alternate; choose a weight you can lift without swinging.

zh: 站姿，双脚与髋同宽，双手各持一只哑铃垂在体侧，沉肩，手肘微弯。
呼气，严格不借力，沿肩胛平面（手臂比身体略偏前 15°–30°）向两侧抬起，手肘引领。
抬到肩高即可，顶峰停顿片刻，不耸肩。
吸气用约 2 秒缓慢放下，不要让哑铃砸下。
重量不要太重，动作不能靠身体摆动。
en: Stand with feet hip-width, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, shoulders down and elbows slightly bent.
Exhale and raise the dumbbells out to the sides with strict form and no swinging, along the scapular plane (arms 15°–30° in front of the body), elbows leading.
Stop at shoulder height, pause briefly at the top and don't shrug.
Inhale and lower over about 2 seconds without letting the weights drop.
Keep the weight moderate and don't use body swing.

zh: 站姿，双脚与髋同宽，双手各持一只哑铃放在大腿前侧，膝盖微屈并固定。
吸气，核心收紧，屁股水平向后推，哑铃紧贴大腿和小腿下放。
下放到感觉腘绳肌被拉伸为止，全程背部中立，不弓背。
呼气，臀部发力向前顶髋站直，哑铃回到起始位置。
膝盖角度全程不变，动作像是铰链而不是下蹲。
en: Stand with feet hip-width, a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs and knees slightly bent and fixed.
Inhale, brace the core and push the hips straight back, lowering the dumbbells close to the thighs and shins.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch, keeping the back neutral and never rounded.
Exhale and drive the hips forward with the glutes to stand tall.
Keep the knee angle unchanged; this is a hinge, not a squat.

zh: 坐在凳子上（靠背调直），双脚踩稳，双手持哑铃放在肩两侧，手肘在肩胛平面内（约 30°–45°），不要外展到 90°。
核心收紧，沉肩，呼气向上推起哑铃，手臂接近伸直但不锁死。
顶峰哑铃微微向内靠拢，不要耸肩。
吸气缓慢下放到哑铃接近耳朵高度，手肘保持在肩胛平面。
肩前不适时，可换成 地雷管推举。
en: Sit on a bench with the back pad upright and feet planted, dumbbells at shoulder level with elbows tucked in about 30°–45° (scapular plane), not flared to 90°.
Brace the core, keep the shoulders down and exhale as you press the dumbbells up until the arms are nearly straight, not locked.
Let the dumbbells come slightly together at the top without shrugging.
Inhale and lower slowly to about ear level, keeping the elbows in the scapular plane.
Switch to a landmine press if the front of the shoulder bothers you.

zh: 站姿，双手各持一只哑铃垂在体侧，核心收紧，挺胸沉肩。
向前迈一大步，屈膝下蹲，后膝接近地面，前膝与脚尖同向，不内扣。
前腿发力站起，同时把后腿向前迈到前面，成为下一步的前腿。
躯干保持稳定，每一步都用前腿发力站起，一侧一步交替前行。
走完一段距离或做完一定步数后休息。
en: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, core braced, chest up and shoulders down.
Take a long step forward and lower until the back knee nears the floor, the front knee in line with the toes and not caving in.
Stand up by driving through the front leg, bringing the back leg forward into the next step.
Keep the torso stable and alternate legs with each step as you walk forward.
Rest after a set distance or number of steps.

zh: 站姿，双脚与髋同宽，握住曲杆的内侧或外侧弯曲处，使用半旋后握位，手臂垂在身前。
沉肩，核心收紧，大臂固定在身体两侧。
呼气，屈肘把杠铃卷向肩部，曲杆半旋后握位减轻手腕压力。
顶峰停顿片刻，吸气缓慢控制下放到手臂伸直。
完成次数，躯干不要借力摆动。
en: Stand with feet hip-width, hold the EZ-bar on its angled grips in a semi-supinated grip with the arms hanging in front.
Set the shoulders down, brace the core and fix the upper arms at your sides.
Exhale and curl the bar toward the shoulders; the semi-supinated grip eases wrist stress.
Pause briefly at the top, then inhale and lower under control to full extension.
Complete all reps without swinging the torso.

zh: 仰卧，把泡沫轴横放在中上背（不滚腰椎）下方，屈膝，双脚踩地。
双手放在头后托住颈部，抱头收肋骨，下巴微收。
呼气，缓慢向后伸展胸椎，越过泡沫轴，感觉胸椎被打开。
每个位置向后伸展 5 次，共 2–3 个位置，沿中上背逐个移动。
起身时先侧身转下，不要用力扭腰。
en: Lie on your back with a foam roller placed across the mid-upper back (not the lower back), knees bent and feet flat.
Support the head with the hands behind it, ribs down and chin slightly tucked.
Exhale and slowly extend the thoracic spine back over the roller, feeling it open up.
Extend back 5 times at each of 2–3 positions, moving along the mid-upper back.
Roll to the side to get up and don't twist the lower back hard.

zh: 先在水里慢游或做陆上热身 5–10 分钟，活动肩部和髋部。
主体部分按距离或时间分组游自由泳，每组之间休息 30–60 秒。
自由泳要求高频率肩内旋；若肩前有卡压感，就放慢速度、缩短距离或换蛙泳，疼痛即停。
结束前放松慢游 3–5 分钟，让心率回落。
上岸后做肩部、胸部和背部的轻柔拉伸。
en: Warm up with 5–10 minutes of easy swimming or dry-land moves for the shoulders and hips.
For the main set, swim freestyle in sets by distance or time, resting 30–60 seconds between sets.
Freestyle demands a lot of repeated shoulder internal rotation; if the front of the shoulder pinches, slow down, shorten the distance or switch to breaststroke, and stop if it hurts.
Cool down with 3–5 minutes of easy swimming so the heart rate settles.
Afterward do gentle stretches for the shoulders, chest and back.

zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚踩地与髋同宽，手臂放在体侧（或把哑铃放在髋部）。
收腹，骨盆后倾，下背贴地。
呼气，用臀部发力向上顶髋，直到膝、髋、肩成一条直线。
顶峰夹紧臀部停 2 秒，不要用下背顶起。
吸气缓慢放下，臀部轻触地面再开始下一次。
en: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet hip-width on the floor, arms at your sides (or a dumbbell on the hips).
Draw in the abs and tuck the pelvis with the lower back flat on the floor.
Exhale and drive the hips up with the glutes until knees, hips and shoulders form a line.
Squeeze the glutes for 2 seconds at the top, without pushing up with the lower back.
Inhale and lower slowly, tapping the glutes lightly on the floor before the next rep.

zh: 双脚略宽于肩站立，脚尖微外展，双手把哑铃贴胸抱在身前，躯干自然挺直。
吸气稳住核心，髋膝同时弯曲，向下蹲，膝盖始终朝向脚尖方向。
用约 2 秒控制下蹲至大腿与地面平行或略低，躯干保持挺直。
呼气，脚掌踩实地面发力站起，回到起始位置。
全程重心在脚掌中部，不让膝盖内扣。
en: Stand with feet slightly wider than the shoulders and toes turned out a little, holding a dumbbell at the chest with the torso naturally upright.
Inhale and brace the core, then bend the hips and knees together to squat down, knees tracking over the toes.
Lower over about 2 seconds to thighs parallel or slightly below, keeping the torso upright.
Exhale and drive through the whole foot to stand back up.
Keep the weight over the mid-foot and don't let the knees cave in.

zh: 站上哈克深蹲机，背部和臀部贴紧靠垫，双脚与肩同宽踩在踏板中部，肩部顶住垫子。
解开保险，伸直腿站起，膝盖不锁死。
吸气，缓慢屈膝下蹲，背部全程贴紧靠垫，控制下蹲深度。
呼气，脚掌踩实发力推起，回到起始位置。
完成次数后把保险扣上。
en: Step into the hack squat machine with the back and hips against the pad, feet shoulder-width on the middle of the platform and shoulders under the pads.
Release the safety and straighten the legs without locking the knees.
Inhale and bend the knees to squat down slowly, keeping the back against the pad and controlling the depth.
Exhale and push through the whole foot back to the start.
Re-engage the safety after the last rep.

zh: 双手握住单杠，悬垂，肩部下沉，核心收紧，双腿并拢。
呼气，卷动骨盆向胸口靠拢，同时屈膝提起，不要只抬大腿练髂腰肌。
顶峰停顿片刻，感受下腹收缩。
吸气缓慢控制下放，腿回到悬垂位置，不晃动。
完成次数，如果晃动过大，先停一下稳住再做。
en: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip, shoulders down, core braced and legs together.
Exhale and curl the pelvis toward the chest as you bring the knees up, rather than only lifting the thighs (which trains the hip flexors).
Pause briefly at the top and feel the lower abs contract.
Inhale and lower the legs under control to the hanging position without swinging.
If you swing too much, stop and steady yourself before the next rep.

zh: 坐在器械上，背部贴紧靠垫，双脚踩在踏板上，大腿外侧靠住护垫，双手握住把手。
核心收紧，骨盆稳定，不要顶腰。
呼气，向两侧推开腿，推到最大幅度，停 1 秒。
吸气缓慢控制收回，不让配重片砸下。
完成次数，强化臀中肌稳定膝关节。
en: Sit in the machine with the back against the pad, feet on the foot plates, outer thighs against the pads and hands on the handles.
Brace the core and keep the pelvis stable without arching the lower back.
Exhale and push the legs out to full range and pause 1 second.
Inhale and return slowly under control without dropping the stack.
Complete all reps, building the glute medius that stabilizes the knee.

zh: 坐在器械上，背部贴紧靠垫，大腿内侧靠住护垫，起始位置把腿打开到舒适的范围，双手握住把手。
核心收紧，骨盆稳定。
呼气，把双腿向中间合拢，合拢处停 1 秒夹紧。
吸气缓慢控制打开，切勿借惯性猛放。
完成次数，全程保持节奏稳定。
en: Sit in the machine with the back against the pad, inner thighs against the pads, set the start with the legs open to a comfortable range and hold the handles.
Brace the core and keep the pelvis stable.
Exhale and bring the legs together, squeezing for 1 second at the center.
Inhale and open slowly under control, never letting momentum swing the legs open.
Complete all reps at a steady tempo.

zh: 半跪姿，一侧膝盖跪在垫子上，另一脚在前，成弓步姿势，躯干挺直。
先收紧后侧臀部，使骨盆后倾，避免顶腰。
保持臀部收紧，轻微向前移动身体，直到跪着一侧大腿根前侧有拉伸感。
保持 20–30 秒，自然呼吸，不要顶腰。
缓慢放回，休息后换另一侧。
en: Get into a half-kneeling position with one knee on a mat and the other foot in front in a lunge stance, torso tall.
First squeeze the glute on the kneeling side to tilt the pelvis back, so you don't arch the lower back.
Keeping that glute tight, shift slightly forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the kneeling hip.
Hold 20–30 seconds, breathing normally and without arching the lower back.
Release slowly and rest, then switch sides.

zh: 把凳子调到 30°–45° 上斜，仰卧，双脚踩实，肩胛后缩下沉。
握距略宽于肩，把杠铃推起至肩关节正上方并稳住核心。
控制下放杠铃至锁骨下方，手肘微内收，减少肩前卡压。
呼气推起杠铃回到起始位置，肩胛始终贴住凳面。
做完后把杠铃稳稳放回挂钩，重量大时请保护者协助。
en: Set the bench to a 30°–45° incline, lie back with feet planted and shoulder blades back and down.
Take a grip slightly wider than the shoulders, unrack the bar over the shoulder joints and brace the core.
Lower the bar under control to just below the collarbone, elbows tucked slightly to reduce front-shoulder pinching.
Exhale and press back to the start, keeping the shoulder blades against the bench.
Rack the bar securely at the end; use a spotter for heavy sets.

zh: 把凳子调到 45°–60° 上斜，仰靠在上面，双手各持一只哑铃，手臂自然下垂，肱二头肌长头被充分拉伸。
沉肩，肩部和背部贴紧凳子，大臂始终保持垂直地面。
呼气，屈肘卷起哑铃，大臂不动，小臂旋外。
顶峰停顿片刻，吸气缓慢下放到手臂完全伸直。
重量要轻一些，不用肩膀往前送。
en: Set a bench to 45°–60° incline and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging so the long head of the biceps is fully stretched.
Keep the shoulders down and pressed against the bench, with the upper arms staying vertical.
Exhale and curl the dumbbells up without moving the upper arms, rotating the forearms outward.
Pause briefly at the top, then inhale and lower slowly to full extension.
Use a lighter weight and don't push the shoulders forward to cheat.

zh: 调好座椅，使把手位于上胸高度，肩胛贴紧靠背，双脚踩实。
握住把手，沉肩挺胸，保持肩胛贴背。
呼气沿固定轨迹向前上方推出，手臂接近伸直但不锁死。
吸气用 2 秒缓慢还原，控制离心下放，不让配重片砸下。
完成次数，全程肩部不耸起。
en: Set the seat so the handles line up with the upper chest, shoulder blades pinned to the back pad and feet planted.
Take the handles, shoulders down and chest up, keeping the shoulder blades against the pad.
Exhale and press forward and up along the fixed path until the arms are nearly straight but not locked.
Inhale and lower for 2 seconds, controlling the eccentric without letting the stack crash.
Finish all reps without letting the shoulders creep up.

zh: 先在平地用 3–5 分钟慢走热身，再把坡度调到 8–12%。
把速度设在 4.5–5.5 km/h，保持能完整说话的二区心率。
双手不扶扶手，身体略前倾，步幅自然，保持 20–40 分钟。
结束前 3–5 分钟把坡度降到 0 慢走，让心率回落。
完成后做小腿和臀腿拉伸，并补充水分。
en: Warm up with 3–5 minutes of easy flat walking, then set the incline to 8–12%.
Set the speed at 4.5–5.5 km/h, keeping a zone-2 heart rate where you can still speak in full sentences.
Keep your hands off the rails, lean slightly forward and walk naturally for 20–40 minutes.
For the last 3–5 minutes drop the incline to 0 and walk slowly so the heart rate settles.
Finish with calf and leg stretches and drink some water.

zh: 双脚略宽于肩站立，壶铃放在身前一步，髋铰链俯身，双手握住壶铃，把壶铃向后荡到两腿之间。
背部平直，核心收紧，沉肩。
靠屈髋铰链与臀部爆发力向前顶髋，把壶铃送到胸高，手臂只是绳子，不主动前平举。
壶铃在顶点漂浮，然后让它自然落下，髋部向后铰链，把壶铃荡回两腿之间。
保持稳定节奏做完每一组，动力来自臀部而不是手臂。
en: Stand with feet slightly wider than the shoulders, the kettlebell a step in front; hinge forward, grip it and hike it back between the legs.
Keep the back flat, core braced and shoulders down.
Power comes from the hip hinge and glute drive: snap the hips forward to send the kettlebell to chest height; the arms are only ropes and don't lift actively.
Let the bell float at the top, then let it fall and hinge the hips back to swing it between the legs.
Keep a steady rhythm through each set, with the drive coming from the glutes and not the arms.

zh: 调好靠背，坐稳，下背和臀部贴紧靠垫，双脚与肩同宽踩在踏板中部。
解开保险，伸直双腿把踏板推到起点，膝盖不锁死。
吸气，缓慢屈膝下放，直到膝盖约 90°，下背和臀部绝不离开靠垫。
呼气，脚掌踩实发力推起，推起时膝盖不锁死。
完成次数后重新扣上保险。
en: Adjust the backrest and sit with the lower back and hips pressed into the pad, feet shoulder-width on the middle of the platform.
Release the safety and extend the legs to the start position without locking the knees.
Inhale and lower slowly until the knees reach about 90°, never letting the lower back or hips lift off the pad.
Exhale and press through the whole foot to push up, without locking the knees at the top.
Re-engage the safety after the last rep.

zh: 调好靠背，坐稳，下背和臀部贴紧靠垫，双脚与肩同宽放在踏板偏上方。
解开保险，伸直双腿把踏板推到起点，膝盖不锁死。
吸气，缓慢屈膝屈髋下放，膝屈角度小、屈髋幅度大，更多刺激臀大肌与腘绳肌。
下放到臀部即将离垫之前，呼气蹬脚后跟推起。
完成次数后重新扣上保险。
en: Adjust the backrest and sit with the lower back and hips on the pad, feet shoulder-width and high on the platform.
Release the safety and extend the legs to the start position without locking the knees.
Inhale and lower slowly, bending the knees less and the hips more, which works the glutes and hamstrings harder.
Stop just before the hips start to lift off the pad, then exhale and push through the heels.
Re-engage the safety after the last rep.

zh: 把滑轮调到低位，双手各握一个把手，掌心向上，向前迈一步站稳，躯干略前倾。
手肘微弯固定，双臂向两侧下方展开到胸部有拉伸感。
呼气，掌心向上沿斜上方环抱，双手在锁骨前方合拢，专注上胸收缩。
合拢处停 1 秒，再吸气缓慢还原。
全程手肘角度不变，避免用肩前束和手臂代偿。
en: Set the pulleys low, hold a handle in each hand with palms up, and step forward into a stable stance with a slight forward lean.
Keep a slight fixed bend in the elbows and open the arms out and down until you feel a chest stretch.
Exhale and hug up and in, palms up, until the hands meet in front of the collarbone, focusing on the upper chest squeeze.
Pause 1 second at the top, then inhale and return slowly.
Keep the elbow angle constant and avoid letting the front delts and arms take over.

zh: 俯卧在腿弯举器上，膝盖在凳边外，小腿垫在脚踝后方，双手握住把手。
骨盆贴紧垫子，核心收紧，不要翘屁股。
呼气，屈膝把小腿拉向臀部，顶峰停 1 秒。
吸气缓慢还原，用约 2 秒放下，控制离心。
完成次数，全程骨盆不离垫。
en: Lie face down on the leg curl machine with the knees just past the bench edge, the pad behind the ankles and hands on the handles.
Press the hips into the pad and brace the core, without lifting the butt.
Exhale and curl the heels toward the glutes, pausing 1 second at the peak.
Inhale and lower slowly over about 2 seconds, controlling the eccentric.
Complete all reps with the hips staying on the pad.

zh: 调整座椅，使把手与中下胸同高，坐稳后背部和肩部贴紧靠垫。
沉肩，握住把手（有对握把手时优先选用，更能减轻肩前压力）。
呼气向前推出，直到手臂接近伸直但肘关节不锁死。
吸气缓慢还原，感觉胸部被拉伸，肩部始终不离靠垫。
保持稳定节奏完成次数，配重片不要砸下。
en: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at mid-to-lower chest height, with your back and shoulders against the pad.
Set the shoulders down and take the handles; use the neutral grip if available, as it takes stress off the front of the shoulder.
Exhale and press forward until the arms are nearly straight, without locking the elbows.
Inhale and return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest, shoulders staying on the pad.
Keep a steady tempo for all reps and don't let the stack crash down.

zh: 调好座椅，使肩与器械转轴同高，背部贴紧靠垫，手臂放在护垫内侧。
沉肩，握住把手，核心收紧。
呼气，用手肘外侧推起衬垫，向侧上方抬到与肩同高，避免耸肩。
顶峰停顿片刻，吸气缓慢控制下放。
完成次数，全程肩部下沉。
en: Adjust the seat so the shoulders line up with the machine's pivot, back against the pad and arms inside the pads.
Set the shoulders down against the pad, hold the handles and brace the core.
Exhale and push the pads up and out with the outsides of the elbows to shoulder height, avoiding any shrugging.
Pause briefly at the top, then inhale and lower under control.
Complete all reps with the shoulders staying down.

zh: 调好座椅和胸垫，胸口贴紧靠垫稳定躯干，双脚踩稳，握住把手，手臂伸直。
先沉肩，再后缩肩胛，保持胸口挺起。
呼气，把把手拉向腹部两侧，手肘向后。
顶峰停 1 秒，夹紧中背。
吸气缓慢还原到手臂伸直，全程胸口不离靠垫。
en: Adjust the seat and chest pad, press the chest against the pad to stabilize the torso, plant the feet and hold the handles with the arms straight.
Set the shoulders down first, then draw the shoulder blades back, keeping the chest up.
Exhale and pull the handles toward the sides of the belly, elbows going back.
Pause 1 second at the end of the pull, squeezing the mid-back.
Inhale and return slowly to straight arms, keeping the chest on the pad throughout.

zh: 调好座椅高度，使把手位于肩部略上方，背部贴紧靠垫，双脚踩稳。
优先选用对握（掌心相对）的把手，降低肩峰下撞击的风险。
沉肩，呼气向上推起至手臂接近伸直，不锁死肘关节，不耸肩。
吸气缓慢下放，把手降到大约与耳朵同高。
保持背部贴靠垫，避免下背过度弓起。
en: Adjust the seat so the handles start just above shoulder height, back against the pad and feet planted.
Prefer the neutral (palms facing) handles to lower the risk of subacromial impingement.
Set the shoulders down and exhale as you press up until the arms are nearly straight, elbows not locked, no shrugging.
Inhale and lower slowly until the handles are about ear height.
Keep the back on the pad and avoid over-arching the lower back.

zh: 在高位下拉器上装好 V 把或平行对握把，坐稳并压好大腿垫，身体略后倾。
握住把手，先沉肩，挺胸。
吸气后呼气，手肘贴近身体向下向后，把把手拉向下胸。
拉到最低点停 1 秒夹紧背阔肌，肩部不要上耸。
缓慢还原到手臂伸直，感受背阔肌被拉伸，再开始下一次。
en: Attach a V-handle or parallel-grip handle to the high pulley, sit down, lock the thigh pad and lean back slightly.
Take the handle, set the shoulders down and lift the chest.
Exhale and pull the handle toward the lower chest, keeping the elbows close to the body and driving them down and back.
Pause 1 second at the bottom to squeeze the lats, without shrugging.
Return slowly until the arms are straight and the lats are stretched, then repeat.

zh: 一手一膝撑在凳子上，另一脚踩地，背部保持水平，另一只手握住哑铃自然下垂。
沉肩，核心收紧，让脊柱保持中立。
呼气，沿弧线把哑铃拉向髋部（像放进裤兜），而不是拉向胸口，减少上斜方代偿。
顶峰停 1 秒，夹紧背阔肌和中背，然后吸气缓慢下放到手臂伸直。
一侧完成全部次数后换另一侧。
en: Place one hand and the same-side knee on a bench, the other foot on the floor, back flat, and hold a dumbbell hanging in the free hand.
Set the shoulder down and brace the core to keep the spine neutral.
Exhale and row the dumbbell in an arc to the hip (as if into a pocket) rather than the chest, to reduce upper-trap takeover.
Pause 1 second at the top, squeezing the lat and mid-back, then lower slowly to full arm extension.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch.

zh: 站姿或坐姿，握距略宽于肩，杠铃放在锁骨前，手肘略朝前。
收紧臀部和腹部，防止下背过度弓起，吸气稳住核心。
呼气，杠铃贴近下巴，沿直线向上推起，头略后移让杠铃通过，推过头顶后头回到中立。
顶峰手臂伸直，耳朵在手臂前方，肩部不过度耸起。
吸气缓慢下放回锁骨前，下一次重新绷紧臀腹。
en: Stand or sit, grip the bar slightly wider than the shoulders and rest it at the collarbone with the elbows slightly forward.
Squeeze the glutes and abs to stop the lower back over-arching, and brace with a breath in.
Exhale and press the bar up in a straight line close to the chin, moving the head back slightly to let it pass and returning it to neutral overhead.
At the top the arms are straight with the head slightly through, without shrugging hard.
Inhale and lower back to the collarbone, re-bracing glutes and abs on each rep.

zh: 背对滑轮站立，握住绳索举到头后，一脚在前站稳，身体微微前倾，核心收紧。
大臂保持贴近耳侧，肘部朝前，起始时屈肘让绳索落在头后。
呼气，伸肘向前上方推出，重点拉伸刺激三头长头。
顶峰手臂伸直停 1 秒，吸气缓慢还原到屈肘位置。
肩内旋受限或肘部不适时降低重量，避免过度后拉。
en: Stand facing away from the pulley, hold the rope behind the head, with one foot forward for stability, a slight forward lean and the core braced.
Keep the upper arms close to the ears with the elbows pointing forward, starting with the elbows bent and the rope behind the head.
Exhale and extend the elbows forward and up, mainly stretching and working the long head of the triceps.
Pause 1 second with the arms straight, then inhale and return slowly to the bent position.
Lower the weight if your shoulder or elbow is irritated and avoid over-stretching behind the head.

zh: 侧对龙门架站立，滑轮调到胸高，双手握住把手，贴在胸前，双脚与肩同宽、膝盖微屈。
核心收紧，骨盆和躯干保持朝向前方，抵抗滑轮的侧向拉力。
呼气，沿胸前直线把把手向正前方推出，手臂伸直。
手臂伸直处停 2 秒，吸气缓慢收回到胸前。
一侧做完全部次数后换另一侧。
en: Stand side-on to a cable machine with the pulley at chest height, hold the handle at the chest with feet shoulder-width and knees slightly bent.
Brace the core and keep the pelvis and torso facing forward against the sideways pull of the cable.
Exhale and press the handle straight out in front of the chest until the arms are straight.
Hold 2 seconds at full extension, then inhale and bring it back to the chest.
Finish all reps on one side, then switch.

zh: 调好座椅高度，使把手与胸部同高，背部贴紧靠垫，沉肩挺胸。
手臂（或小臂）贴住护垫，打开至与躯干平齐的位置作为起点。
呼气，用手肘带动手臂向中间合拢，在合拢处停 1 秒。
吸气缓慢还原，只打开到手臂与躯干平齐即可，不要继续后拉。
全程肩部保持下沉，背部不离开靠垫。
en: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height, back against the pad, shoulders down and chest up.
Place the arms (or forearms) on the pads and open to the point where they are level with the torso.
Exhale and lead with the elbows to bring the arms together, pausing 1 second at the center.
Inhale and return slowly, opening only until the arms are level with the torso and no further.
Keep the shoulders down and the back on the pad throughout.

zh: 俯卧撑地，小臂撑地，手肘在肩正下方，脚尖着地，双脚略分开。
收紧腹肌与臀大肌，骨盆微后倾，身体成一条直线。
保持姿势，臀部不塌腰也不撅起，头部保持中立，呼吸平稳。
坚持 20–60 秒或做到姿势开始变形为止。
结束时慢慢放下膝盖，休息后再做下一组。
en: Get face down and prop on the forearms with elbows directly under the shoulders, toes on the floor and feet slightly apart.
Brace the abs and glutes with a slight posterior pelvic tilt so the body forms one line.
Hold the position with hips neither sagging nor piking up, head neutral and breathing steady.
Hold for 20–60 seconds, or until your form starts to break down.
Lower the knees to finish and rest before the next set.

zh: 坐在牧师凳前，调好座椅高度，使腋下贴住斜板上沿，大臂完整贴靠斜板，握住杠铃或哑铃。
沉肩，核心收紧，起始时手臂接近伸直。
呼气，屈肘把重量卷向肩部，大臂不离斜板，没有借力。
顶峰停顿片刻，吸气缓慢下放，到肘微屈即可，底部不完全锁死，以免拉伤肌腱。
重量要轻一些，肘部不适时立刻停止。
en: Sit at the preacher bench with the seat adjusted so the armpits sit at the top of the pad and the upper arms rest fully on it, holding the bar or dumbbells.
Set the shoulders down and brace the core, starting with the arms nearly straight.
Exhale and curl the weight toward the shoulders, keeping the upper arms on the pad with no momentum.
Pause briefly at the top, then inhale and lower until the elbows are just slightly bent, not fully locking out at the bottom, to protect the tendon.
Use a lighter weight and stop at once if the elbows hurt.

zh: 正手握杠，握距略宽于肩，悬垂，双腿可略屈膝交叉。
先沉肩启动，让背阔肌先发力，核心收紧。
呼气，手肘向下向后，把胸口迎向横杆，拉到下巴过杆，避免耸肩代偿。
吸气，用 2 秒左右缓慢下放，直到手臂接近伸直。
全程不要借助身体摆动，做不到标准次数时可改用辅助引体向上。
en: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than the shoulders, knees bent and legs optionally crossed.
Start by setting the shoulders down so the lats engage first, and brace the core.
Exhale and drive the elbows down and back, bringing the chest toward the bar until the chin clears it, with no shrugging.
Inhale and lower over about 2 seconds until the arms are nearly straight.
Don't swing for momentum; use the assisted pull-up if you can't do full reps.

zh: 双手撑地略宽于肩，双脚并拢或略分开，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
收紧腹部和臀部，吸气，手肘与躯干约 45° 向后屈肘下放。
胸口接近地面时停顿一下，肩胛骨保持自由滑动，不要耸肩。
呼气撑起身体回到起始位置，全程腰部不塌也不撅臀。
做不动标准动作时，可以改为跪姿或把手撑在较高的台面上。
en: Place the hands on the floor slightly wider than the shoulders, feet together or slightly apart, body in one line from head to heels.
Brace the abs and glutes, inhale, and bend the elbows to lower, keeping them about 45° from the torso.
Pause briefly with the chest close to the floor, letting the shoulder blades move freely without shrugging.
Exhale and push back up to the start, with no sagging lower back or piking hips.
If full push-ups are too hard, drop to the knees or place the hands on a raised surface.

zh: 坐在凳边俯身，胸口贴近大腿，或胸贴上斜凳，双手各持轻哑铃垂在膝下方。
背部保持平直，手肘微弯，核心收紧。
呼气，向两侧外展举起哑铃到肩高，专注肩后束。
顶峰停顿片刻，不要用力夹肩胛，以免斜方肌代偿。
吸气缓慢放下，使用轻重量，动作不借力摆动。
en: Sit at the edge of a bench and hinge forward with the chest near the thighs, or lie chest-down on an incline bench, holding light dumbbells hanging below.
Keep the back flat, elbows slightly bent and core braced.
Exhale and raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height, focusing on the rear delts.
Pause briefly at the top without pinching the shoulder blades hard, or the traps take over.
Inhale and lower slowly; use light weights and don't swing.

zh: 站姿，双手各持一只哑铃垂在体侧，核心收紧，挺胸沉肩。
一条腿向后迈一大步，屈膝下蹲，前侧胫骨保持接近垂直，比前跨弓步对膝关节更友好。
后膝接近地面，前膝与脚尖同向，不内扣。
呼气，前脚掌踩实发力站起，收回后腿回到起始位置。
一侧完成全部次数后换另一侧。
en: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, core braced, chest up and shoulders down.
Step one leg back and lower down, keeping the front shin close to vertical, which is easier on the knee than a forward lunge.
Bring the back knee close to the floor with the front knee in line with the toes and not caving in.
Exhale and drive through the front foot to stand, bringing the back leg in to the start.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch.

zh: 调好座椅，面对靠垫坐，胸口贴紧，双手握住把手，手臂在身体正前方。
沉肩，手肘微弯固定，核心收紧。
呼气，手肘引领，向身体两侧远端画弧线打开手臂，专注三角肌后束。
打开到手臂与肩同高即可，停 1 秒，避免耸肩。
吸气缓慢还原，不要让配重片砸下。
en: Adjust the seat and sit facing the pad with the chest against it, holding the handles with the arms in front.
Set the shoulders down, keep the elbows slightly bent and fixed, and brace the core.
Exhale and sweep the arms out wide in an arc, leading with the elbows and focusing on the rear delts.
Open to about shoulder height, pause 1 second, and avoid shrugging.
Inhale and return slowly without letting the stack crash.

zh: 坐稳，双脚绑好脚带，握住把手，手臂伸直，小腿接近垂直。
先热身 5 分钟，用轻阻力慢划。
每桨的发力顺序：先蹬腿，再身体后仰，最后拉桨到腹部；回桨顺序相反：先伸臂，再前倾，最后屈膝，背部保持平直。
主体部分保持稳定节奏和中等强度 15–30 分钟。
结束前慢划 3–5 分钟放松，并拉伸腿部和背部。
en: Sit down, strap the feet in, grip the handle with straight arms and the shins close to vertical.
Warm up for 5 minutes with light resistance and an easy pace.
Drive in this order: legs, then lean back, then pull the handle to the belly; reverse it on the recovery: arms, then lean forward, then bend the knees, keeping the back flat.
Hold a steady rhythm at moderate intensity for 15–30 minutes.
Cool down with 3–5 minutes of easy rowing, then stretch the legs and back.

zh: 坐在划船器前，双脚踩稳踏板，膝盖微屈，握住宽握把手，背部挺直。
先沉肩，保持胸口挺起，手臂向前伸直，感到背部被拉伸。
呼气，把把手拉向下胸位置，同时后缩肩胛，重点收缩中下斜方肌和菱形肌。
在拉到底时停 1 秒，注意不耸肩，躯干不要大幅后仰。
吸气缓慢还原到手臂伸直，下一次从沉肩开始。
en: Sit at the row station with feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, hold the wide handle and keep the back tall.
Set the shoulders down, keep the chest up and reach the arms forward until you feel the back stretch.
Exhale and pull the handle to the lower chest while retracting the shoulder blades, mainly hitting the mid / lower traps and rhomboids.
Pause 1 second at the end of the pull without shrugging or leaning far back.
Inhale and return slowly to full arm extension, resetting the shoulders down for each rep.

zh: 坐在提踵器上，前脚掌踩稳，脚跟悬空，护垫压在膝盖上方，屈膝状态下重点刺激比目鱼肌。
吸气，脚跟缓慢下沉，在最低点停 1 秒，充分拉伸。
呼气，踮脚尖尽可能高，在最高点挤压小腿。
吸气缓慢放下，用完整行程，不要弹跳借力。
完成次数，保持稳定节奏。
en: Sit at the calf raise machine with the balls of the feet planted, heels hanging off and the pad above the knees; with the knee bent this mainly works the soleus.
Inhale and lower the heels slowly, pausing 1 second at the bottom for a full stretch.
Exhale and rise as high as you can onto the toes, squeezing the calves at the top.
Lower under control through the full range without bouncing.
Complete all reps at a steady tempo.

zh: 调好靠背和护垫，使膝关节轴心对准器械转轴，大腿压垫压紧，小腿护垫在脚踝后方。
背部贴紧靠垫，双手握住把手。
呼气，屈膝把小腿向下向后拉到底部，顶峰停 1 秒。
吸气缓慢还原，享受离心拉伸，不让配重片砸下。
完成次数，全程臀部不离座。
en: Adjust the backrest and pads so the knee joint lines up with the pivot, thigh pad pressed down firmly and the shin pad behind the ankles.
Press the back against the pad and hold the handles.
Exhale and curl the lower legs down and back all the way, pausing 1 second at the peak.
Inhale and return slowly, enjoying the eccentric stretch without letting the stack crash.
Complete all reps with the hips staying in the seat.

zh: 调好靠背和护垫，使膝关节轴心对准器械转轴，小腿护垫在脚踝上方。
背部贴紧靠垫，双手握住把手固定身体。
呼气，踢直双腿到膝盖伸直，顶峰停 1 秒夹紧股四头肌。
吸气，用约 2 秒缓慢放下，不砸配重片。
完成次数，全程臀部不离座。
en: Adjust the backrest and pad so the knee joint lines up with the machine's pivot and the shin pad sits just above the ankles.
Press the back against the pad and hold the handles to stay in place.
Exhale and extend the legs fully, pausing 1 second at the top to squeeze the quads.
Inhale and lower for 2 seconds without dropping the stack.
Complete all reps with the hips staying in the seat.

zh: 面对墙站立，小臂贴墙，手肘在肩正下方，双脚离墙一步，核心收紧。
轻轻推墙，使肩胛骨前引，上背略圆，沉肩不耸肩。
保持推墙的同时，让小臂沿墙向上滑动，肩胛骨上回旋，到无痛的最高点。
顶端停 1–2 秒，然后缓慢滑回起始位置。
完成次数，全程沉肩不耸肩，肩部不适时缩小幅度。
en: Stand facing a wall with the forearms on it, elbows directly under the shoulders, feet a step back and core braced.
Press gently into the wall so the shoulder blades protract, with shoulders down and not shrugged.
While keeping that push, slide the forearms up the wall so the shoulder blades rotate upward, up to your pain-free top.
Pause 1–2 seconds at the top, then slide back down slowly.
Complete all reps with the shoulders down, and shorten the range if the shoulder is irritated.

zh: 侧卧，一侧小臂撑地，手肘在肩正下方，双腿伸直叠放，脚的外缘着地。
收紧核心，呼气，把髋部抬离地面，使头、肩、髋、脚成一条直线。
保持姿势，髋部不下沉，也不前后转动，强化腹斜肌与腰方肌。
坚持 20–45 秒，自然呼吸。
缓慢放下，休息后换另一侧。
en: Lie on one side propped on the forearm with the elbow directly under the shoulder, legs straight and stacked, the outer edge of the foot on the floor.
Brace the core and exhale as you lift the hips off the floor so the head, shoulders, hips and feet form one line.
Hold the position with the hips neither sagging nor rotating, working the obliques and quadratus lumborum.
Hold for 20–45 seconds, breathing normally.
Lower slowly and rest, then switch sides.

zh: 面对高位滑轮站立，单手握住把手，双脚前后站稳，身体略前倾，沉肩。
大臂固定在体侧，肘部屈曲到约 90°。
呼气，伸肘向下压到手臂完全伸直，到底部完全收缩三头肌。
吸气缓慢还原，大臂始终保持不动。
一侧做完全部次数后换另一侧。
en: Stand facing a high pulley, hold the handle in one hand with feet staggered, a slight forward lean and the shoulder down.
Fix the upper arm at your side with the elbow bent to about 90°.
Exhale and extend the elbow down until the arm is fully straight, fully contracting the triceps at the bottom.
Inhale and return slowly, keeping the upper arm still the whole time.
Finish all reps on one arm, then switch.

zh: 仰卧在平凳上，双手握住曲杆或哑铃，推起到肩关节上方，手臂伸直。
大臂向头顶方向微倾约 15°，沉肩，核心收紧。
吸气，屈肘下放，杠铃或哑铃落到额头后方，大臂保持不动。
呼气，伸肘推起回到起始位置，只让小臂动。
重量要轻一些，肘部不适时立刻停止。
en: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ-bar or dumbbells pressed up over the shoulders with the arms straight.
Tilt the upper arms about 15° toward the head, shoulders down and core braced.
Inhale and bend the elbows to lower the weight behind the forehead, upper arms staying still.
Exhale and extend the elbows to press back to the start, moving only the forearms.
Use a lighter weight and stop at once if the elbows hurt.

zh: 把凳子调到 30° 上斜，放在史密斯机中间，使杠铃对准锁骨下缘，仰卧，双脚踩实，肩胛后缩下沉。
握距略宽于肩，转动杠铃解锁，推起到肩关节上方。
吸气，缓慢下放到锁骨下缘，手肘约 45°。
呼气，沿固定轨迹推起，回到起始位置。
完成后把杠铃转回挂钩锁住，固定轨迹适合安全冲重量。
en: Set a bench to a 30° incline inside the Smith machine so the bar lines up with the lower collarbone; lie back with feet planted and shoulder blades back and down.
Take a grip slightly wider than the shoulders, rotate the bar to unlock it and press up over the shoulder joints.
Inhale and lower slowly to the lower collarbone with the elbows about 45°.
Exhale and press along the fixed path back to the start.
Rotate the bar back onto the hooks at the end; the fixed path suits pushing heavier weights safely.

zh: 站在提踵器械或台阶上，前脚掌踩稳，脚跟悬空，肩部顶住护垫（或手扶稳），膝盖伸直但不锁死。
吸气，脚跟缓慢下沉，在最低点充分拉伸跟腱，停 1 秒。
呼气，踮脚尖尽可能高，在最高点挤压小腿，停 1 秒。
吸气缓慢放下，用完整行程，不要弹跳借力。
完成次数，全程膝盖保持伸直不弯曲。
en: Stand on a calf raise machine or step with the balls of the feet planted, heels hanging off, shoulders under the pads (or hands holding on), knees straight but not locked.
Inhale and lower the heels slowly, stretching the Achilles fully at the bottom for 1 second.
Exhale and rise as high as you can onto the toes, squeezing the calves for 1 second at the top.
Lower under control through the full range without bouncing.
Complete all reps with the knees staying straight.

zh: 调座高：踩到踏板最低点时，膝盖保持微屈 15°–25°，把手高度舒适，不拱背。
先用轻阻力热身 5 分钟，转速约 80–90 rpm。
主体部分保持二区有氧强度，阻力适中，能完整说话，持续 20–45 分钟。
结束前 3–5 分钟降低阻力，慢踩放松。
关节冲击极小，完成后做大腿和小腿拉伸。
en: Set the saddle so the knee keeps a 15°–25° bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke, with the handlebars at a comfortable height and no hunched back.
Warm up for 5 minutes with light resistance at about 80–90 rpm.
For the main part, keep zone-2 effort with moderate resistance so you can still speak in full sentences, for 20–45 minutes.
Reduce the resistance for the last 3–5 minutes and spin easily to cool down.
This is very low impact; finish with thigh and calf stretches.

zh: 面对踏箱或凳子站立，双手各持一只哑铃垂在体侧，核心收紧。
一只脚全脚掌踩稳踏箱，膝盖朝向脚尖。
呼气，完全靠前腿发力站起，后脚不借力蹬地，顶峰站直。
吸气，缓慢控制下放，后脚轻轻触地后回到起始位置。
一侧做完全部次数后换另一侧。
en: Stand facing a box or bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and the core braced.
Plant one whole foot firmly on the box with the knee tracking over the toes.
Exhale and stand up using only the front leg, without pushing off the back foot, and finish standing tall.
Inhale and lower slowly, tapping the back foot lightly on the floor before the next rep.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch.

zh: 面对高位滑轮站立，双手握住横杆或绳索，上身略前倾，双脚前后站稳。
手肘微弯并固定，肩部下沉，手臂举到头顶前方，感到背阔肌拉伸。
呼气，保持手肘角度不变，用背阔肌发力把横杆或绳索划弧线压向大腿前侧。
在大腿前停 1 秒，感受背阔肌收缩。
吸气缓慢沿原弧线还原，躯干不要晃动。
en: Stand facing the high pulley, hold the bar or rope, lean forward slightly and set the feet in a stable stance.
Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows with the shoulders down and the arms reaching up in front until you feel a lat stretch.
Exhale and sweep the bar or rope down in an arc to the front of the thighs using the lats, elbow angle unchanged.
Pause 1 second at the thighs and feel the lats contract.
Inhale and return along the same arc without rocking the torso.

zh: 跨站在 T 杆上，双脚与肩同宽，对握把手，髋铰链俯身，膝盖微屈，背部平直。
核心收紧，沉肩，让重量悬在地面上方。
呼气，手肘向后，把杠铃拉向腹部，顶峰挤压中背部。
顶峰停 1 秒，躯干角度不变。
吸气缓慢下放，全程背部平直，不用下背甩动。
en: Straddle the T-bar with feet shoulder-width, take the neutral-grip handle, hinge forward with slightly bent knees and a flat back.
Brace the core, set the shoulders down and let the weight hang just off the floor.
Exhale and drive the elbows back, rowing the bar toward the belly and squeezing the mid-back at the top.
Pause 1 second at the top with the torso angle unchanged.
Lower under control, keeping the back flat and not heaving with the lower back.

zh: 站在六角杠中心，双脚与髋同宽，对握把手，重心与杠铃重合。
吸气，核心绷紧，沉肩，背部平直，胸口挺起。
双脚蹬地同时伸髋，站直，杠铃贴近身体。
站直时夹紧臀部，不要后仰。
控制下放回到地面，下背剪切力远小于传统杠铃硬拉。
en: Stand in the center of the hex bar with feet hip-width and take the neutral-grip handles so the weight lines up with your body.
Inhale, brace the core, set the shoulders down and keep the back flat with the chest up.
Drive through the floor and extend the hips to stand, keeping the bar close to the body.
Squeeze the glutes at the top without leaning back.
Lower under control to the floor; the lower-back shear is far less than a conventional barbell deadlift.

zh: 站姿，双脚与髋同宽，双手握杠铃（或哑铃），握距与肩同宽，杠铃放在大腿前。
沉肩，核心收紧，肘部带动，沿身体向上拉到胸口高度。
该动作在负重下强制肩内旋外展，肩峰撞击风险高，也容易让上斜方肌过度代偿，不要拉得过高。
缓慢控制下放杠铃，回到大腿前，不借力摆动。
肩部不适者避免此动作，可换成绳索或哑铃侧平举。
en: Stand with feet hip-width, hold a barbell (or dumbbells) with a shoulder-width grip resting in front of the thighs.
Set the shoulders down, brace the core and lead with the elbows, pulling the weight up along the body to chest height.
This movement forces internal rotation and abduction under load, with a high risk of subacromial impingement, and easily overbuilds the upper traps, so don't pull higher.
Lower the weight under control back to the thighs without swinging.
If your shoulder is irritated, skip this and use cable or dumbbell lateral raises instead.
